title: Saloma Link Active-Mobility Corridor — Illustrative Demo
description: A curated demonstration exploring how Kuala Lumpur Development Plan 2040 active-mobility policy intent may relate to a bounded Kampung Baru / Saloma Link / KLCC Park corridor. Its geometry follows selected real OSM ways; this remains an illustrative route-evidence mapping, not an official construction or accessibility finding.
areaBoundsDescription: North Kampung Baru to Saloma Link and KLCC Park — roughly a 2 km real-street corridor, with a longer 2.49 km cyclist road detour
disclaimer: This is an illustrative private-development fixture for demonstration purposes only. Segment impacts, accessibility findings, and construction timelines are not official. Field verification is required for any real-world claim.
